title: US envoy to meet Putin after 'positive' talks with Zelenskyy
summary: Steve Witkoff landed in St Petersburg for talks on ending the war in Ukraine. It comes a day after he met with Ukrainian President Volodomyr Zelenskyy in Norway.

image.caption: Steve Witkoff was greeted at the airport by Russian presidential envoy Kirill DmitrievImage: Handout/REUTERS

blocks.text: US special envoy Steve Witkoff arrived in Russia on Wednsday morning for talks with President Vladimir Putin about the war in Ukraine.
Witkoff was greeted in St Petersburg by the Kremlin's advisor for international economic cooperation, Kirill Dmitriev.
The meeting comes a day after Witkoff met with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy in Norway, which US Secretary of State Marco Rubio described as "positive."
"He will now, armed with those ideas, be able to ‌go to St Petersburg and share them with the Russian side, and ‌let's ​see if we can make some progress," he said.
